# Spectro demo data

**Simulated, not measured.** The spectra are generated by
`tools/make_demo_data.py` from published band positions and absorptivities
(methanol, 1 cm): paracetamol λmax ≈ 243 nm (A 1 %/1 cm ≈ 668), caffeine
λmax ≈ 273 nm (≈ 502), aspirin λmax ≈ 229 nm (≈ 480). They include realistic
preparation error (≈ 0.3 %), wavelength jitter, baseline offset/tilt, noise
that rises below 215 nm and 4-decimal rounding.

Each file uses a different instrument-software export style, so the importer
can be tried on all of them:

| File | Style | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `binary/shimadzu_txt/PAR_*.txt` | single spectrum, quoted header, descending λ, 0.5 nm | paracetamol standards 2–20 µg/mL |
| `binary/CAF_standards_xy_pairs.csv` | (λ, Abs) column pairs (Cary WinUV style) | caffeine standards 2–20 µg/mL |
| `binary/lab_mixtures.xlsx` | Excel, λ + one column per mixture | 8 laboratory-prepared mixtures |
| `binary/panadol_extra_tablets.csv` | semicolon + decimal comma + metadata lines | 3 tablet solutions (15.38 PAR + 2.0 CAF µg/mL nominal) |
| `binary/methanol_blank.txt` | whitespace with `#` comments | solvent blank |
| `ternary/training_set_brereton.jdx` | JCAMP-DX, 25 blocks | 5-level multifactor design (PAR 6–14, CAF 3–9, ASA 6–18 µg/mL) |
| `ternary/validation_mixtures.tsv` | one spectrum per row | 5 validation mixtures |
| `ternary/excedrin_tablets.spc` | GRAMS SPC multi-file | 3 tablet solutions (12 ASA + 12 PAR + 3.12 CAF µg/mL nominal) |

Concentrations are in the sample names ("PAR 8 CAF 4"), so *Fill
concentrations from names* in the import dialog fills them in automatically.
